stories.title_en: Ingredient-led brands are dominating AI beauty citations
stories.title_zh: Ingredient-led brands are dominating AI beauty citations
stories.desc_en: According to a report from 5W AI Communications, skin-care brands like The Ordinary, Cerave and La Roche-Posay are among the top beauty brands by AI citations. Those results speak to a new discovery model where LLMs like ChatGPT and Google Gemini prioritize ingredients and expert credentials to surface product recommendations. But the AI beauty pipeline still remains undefined.
stories.desc_zh: 根据5W AI Communications的一份报告， The Ordinary、Cerave和La Roche-Posay等护肤品牌是AI引用的顶级美容品牌之一。这些结果说明了一种新的发现模型，在这种模型中，像ChatGPT和Google Gemini这样的LLM会优先考虑成分和专家凭证，从而提出产品推荐。但人工智能美容管道仍未定义。

stories.title_en: Wellness Briefing: Is hormone tracking the future of women’s wearables? Plus news
stories.title_zh: Wellness Briefing: Is hormone tracking the future of women’s wearables? Plus news
stories.desc_en: For the Wellness Briefing, Glossy interviewed Jenny Duan, the 22-year-old founder who has raised $11.6 million to launch a continuous hormone-tracking wearable named Clair. stories.title_en: The Billion-Dollar Seed Isn’t The Deal You Think It Is
stories.title_zh: The Billion-Dollar Seed Isn’t The Deal You Think It Is
stories.desc_en: Despite attention-grabbing AI mega-seed rounds, historical data shows that very large first financings rarely produce venture-scale returns because high entry valuations limit investor upside. Instead, argues guest author Ellie McDonald, the strongest venture outcomes have typically come from capital-efficient startups that raised modest early rounds.
stories.desc_zh: 尽管人工智能大型种子轮引人注目，但历史数据显示，非常大的第一轮融资很少产生风险规模的回报，因为高入场估值限制了投资者的上行空间。客座作家艾莉·麦克唐纳（ Ellie McDonald ）认为，相反，最强劲的风险投资成果通常来自资本效率高的初创公司，这些初创公司在早期进行了适度的融资。
